Laser light causes mid-air circling of Malaysia Airlines flight in Kolkata

A Malaysia Airlines flight experienced mid-air circling at Kolkata airport due to a laser light incident. The pilot was momentarily disoriented by the flash, preventing an immediate landing. The aircraft had to circle before making another approach. Separately, a trainer aircraft veered off the runway at Baramati airstrip with no injuries reported. Another incident involved two planes at Sydney Airport narrowly avoiding a collision on the tarmac, causing flight delays and injuring a cabin crew member.
